verdict_summary: Engineering infrastructure recovery, systemd hardening, lock mitigation, and Python 3.12 CI repair are completely verified and pass all quality gates. However, empirical post-start evidence across 5 slots (06:30-07:30 UTC) confirmed that local proxy routing through a US node caused 5 consecutive HTTP 451 rejections, breaching the frozen consecutive gap threshold of 4. Successors DERIVATIVES_PIT_EPOCH_V0320_001 and H37 are terminal/compromised and cannot be declared healthy accumulating.

findings.finding: Both v0.3.20 successors (DERIVATIVES_PIT_EPOCH_V0320_001 and H37) suffered 5 consecutive failed/missed slots post-start due to Binance HTTP 451, breaching the frozen consecutive gap threshold (5 > 4).
findings.required_action: Mark successors as COMPROMISED_AT_RISK / TERMINAL_BREACH. Do not backfill or shift start boundaries. Preregister clean v0.3.21 successors only after verified compliant non-US network cutover.

findings.finding: Workstation proxy egress via US IP 23.148.204.205 triggers Binance HTTP 451 geo-restrictions.
findings.required_action: Migrate 24/7 forward collection to Linux VPS in compliant region (Frankfurt/Tokyo/Singapore) per docs/LINUX_VPS_MIGRATION_RUNBOOK.md.

findings.finding: Uncached partition status evaluation can cause test run time to jump to ~2.5m on multi-GB SQLite databases.
findings.required_action: Ensure persistent stats caching is preserved or isolate multi-GB integration tests from rapid unit test runs.

falsification_criteria: Binance Futures API calls from collector host succeed with HTTP 200 and all 5 required derivatives fields populated across >=8 consecutive 15m intervals without intervention.
Slot failures proven to be caused by internal software defects/timeouts rather than HTTP 451 geo-restrictions.
Frozen protocol proven to evaluate cumulative rather than consecutive gap limits.
next_stage_recommendations: Do not promote v0.3.20 successors to live accumulating status.
Deploy 24/7 collectors to a compliant non-US Linux VPS using deploy/linux-vps/.
Verify forward_doctor reports HEALTHY with zero HTTP 451 issues.
Preregister v0.3.21 successors on a future UTC boundary after network cutover is proven.
Merge v0.3.20 infrastructure improvements into main as an engineering hardening release.
